name: Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2021/947 as regards increased efficiency of the External Action Guarantee
part_text:
The European Parliament wants to change how the European Union uses a guarantee fund that backs investments in partner countries. The fund lets the EU share risk with banks and development bodies so that private money flows into projects abroad. Parliament says the fund should keep fighting poverty and supporting democracy and human rights. It also asks for more transparency, regular reports to Parliament, and a review of how well the fund works before 2027.

- Parliament adds conditions and reporting duties to the EU guarantee fund for external investments.
- It affects the European Commission, the European Investment Bank and other implementing partners.
- Next, Parliament and EU governments negotiate the final text.
